items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: Jay and I were brought to Chicago with a drummer who was supposed to have won, along there with George Barnes and Anita O'Day who also was supposed to have been the new stars for that time.

ctx.x: Well, that's a result of Dave Dexter?

Probably. Anyway, and in the return we were -- Jay and I were brought to Chicago with a drummer who was supposed to have won, along there with George Barnes and Anita O'Day who also was supposed to have been the new stars for that time.
By the way, did you hear George Barnes died?
